clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, wolf hearts hold a poison their living hosts endure. Apothecary Renferrel sends samples to the Royal Apothecary Society, whose members study them.

Apothecary Renferrel found a deadly compound in certain wolf hearts while examining carcasses in Silverpine Forest. The poison saturates the tissue at a level that should kill the wolves, yet they live. Renferrel set tissue samples aside for delivery to Undercity. The Forsaken study organisms that withstand toxins as they seek to master biological warfare and prepare new reagents.

Couriers carry the samples beneath the ruins of Lordaeron to Apothecary Zinge at the Royal Apothecary Society's headquarters in the Apothecarium. Zinge and her colleagues prize new toxins. They dissect and test the tainted tissue to isolate its virulent compounds and learn how the beasts survive them, hoping to use that knowledge in their alchemical work.
